messages:
lina gomez: Hey folks! I'm Lina — joining as a Backend Infra PM. First week remote from SF. Slightly obsessed with boba and succulents. Excited to be here! Any must-try lunch spots near the Mission? :tada:
marcus li: Welcome Lina!! If you like boba, check out Boba Lab on 16th. Great pork bun two doors down too. :drooling_face:
talia bhat: Hi Lina — welcome! We do a rooftop plant swap on Fridays, bring something small if you can. Also happy to run a quick setup + onboarding walkthrough. :)
jen (people-ops): Welcome!! Quick FYI: onboarding checklist sent — https://redwood.example/onboarding/lina — badge pickup is tomorrow between 10-11am. What size hoodie do you want? :sparkles:
oliver kaz: WFH tip: connect to VPN 'redwood-remote' before 9am to avoid SSO flakiness. Also theres a #lunchmates channel if you want company for going out.
rachael: Mini poll — boba order for a Friday group run? Reply with emoji: 🧋 = classic milk tea, 🍵 = matcha, 🥭 = mango, 🧊 = extra ice. I'll collect and place the order.
lina gomez: 🥭 for me! And Id love the rooftop swap idea — I have a tiny echeveria to contribute.
marcus li: 🧋 +1 to the boba run. Also FYI welcome kit includes a sticker pack (potato mascot is legendary). :potato:
people-ops-bot: Lina gomez has been added to team 'infra' and channels: #eng, #new-hires. Welcome email dispatched.
talia bhat: Quick intro sync tomorrow at 10am? 15 minutes to say hi and cover immediate Qs. Calendar invite or prefer ad-hoc?
lina gomez: Calendar invite works great, thanks everyone — looking forward to meeting y'all in person soon! :smile:
